reviewScope: Four selected cohort9 claims only; disputed Mao death/Taihe campaign and510 remain outside scope; no full chapter/date approval
sharedReasoning: Read all91 complete Chinese units in the four explicitly separated ranges. The mountain citation is demonstrably inside living Ma Ji’s proposal and accepted by Zhang Jun, while King Mu is an old cited subject. Dahuai’s own heir appointment is distinct from Tianxi’s imperial rank confirmation and the disputed exact date of a campaign; its broad existing bound is not a statement that all intervening material is linear chronology. Preserve the retrospective summaries and the literal prospective 六年夏 pledge without resolving its era or converting it into an appointment date. Han Pu’s strike has its own 永昌初 anchor and is not merged with an earlier defence or dated through Mao’s disputed death. No outside year, reign/lifespan interval or counting convention is introduced.

judgments.sourceReason: s0488 酒泉太守馬岌上言 explicitly identifies the current Jiuquan administrator Ma Ji as the speaker of the mountain proposal; s0491 requests a shrine and s0492 駿從之 supplies Zhang Jun’s acceptance. This is current service, not Ma Ji living in King Mu’s legendary time. The own speech occurs in the ruler’s narrative after s0487 永和元年 and before his death s0493, followed by Chonghua’s explicit s0499 永和二年 accession. Those named acts bound the notice within the existing AD345–346 envelope without making it exactly345.

judgments.sourceReason: s0753 太和初 dates Tianxi’s imperial confirmation, a different event from s0769 立子大懷為世子. s0763–s0768 narrate Tianxi’s campaign and return; s0769 then makes Dahuai the recipient of the heir investiture. s0770 自天錫之嗣事也 and s0772 初 explicitly look back, so the following paragraph cannot be treated as a straight new dated sequence by adjacency. Nevertheless s0775 廢大懷…更立…大豫 presupposes Dahuai’s earlier investiture and describes a later replacement; the alliance/mission material leads to the next explicit 太元元年 invasion heading at s0787. The existing broad onOrAfter366/onOrBefore376 context envelope is supportable for Dahuai’s own appointment, without assigning the campaign a disputed exact year, dating the appointment as Taihe1, or converting prospective 克六年夏 to a numbered current year.
